recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中同時可見兩群細胞：一群核質比高、染色質細緻、有核仁、細胞質少的母細胞，另一群核偏位、細胞質深藍、有核周淡染區（hof）的漿細胞；母細胞與大量漿細胞並存，是這個「T 淋巴母細胞白血病合併反應性漿細胞增多」病例的重點。
features: Numerous intermediate-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli
Blast nuclei round to slightly irregular with scant pale-to-moderately basophilic cytoplasm
Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deep blue cytoplasm, and perinuclear hof
Occasional small mature lymphocytes and a few maturing myeloid cells
A large round cell with granular purple rim at lower right, of uncertain nature at this resolution
Cellular aspirate with background platelet and cell debris
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous intermediate-to-large blasts having high N:C ratios, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Admixed are increased mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deep blue cytoplasm, and perinuclear hofs, along with occasional small lymphocytes and maturing myeloid cells. A large cell with a granular purple rim at the lower right cannot be characterized at this resolution. With the reported 36% blasts of T lineage (cCD3+, TdT+) and polyclonal CD38+ plasma cells, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia with reactive plasmacytosis.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with concurrent leukemia
ddx.vs: Myeloma plasma cells are often atypical (binucleation, nucleoli) with light-chain restriction and an M-protein, whereas here plasma cells are polyclonal with polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia.
Plasmablasts are large with prominent central nucleoli and CD138/MUM1 positivity but lack TdT and cCD3.
AML blasts may show granules or Auer rods and are MPO/CD117 positive, whereas these blasts are MPO-negative with cCD3 and TdT expression.
Reactive plasmacytosis (infection, autoimmune disease, HIV) lacks a TdT-positive blast population.
